name: taplio
description: LinkedIn content workspace: plan, write, schedule and measure LinkedIn posts, and manage comments and replies, through your Taplio account.

interface.longDescription:
Taplio is a LinkedIn content and engagement workspace for founders, marketers, sales teams and creators. This plugin runs your LinkedIn content routine on your Taplio account.

Plan and write: research what performs in your niche, draft posts in your voice, attach images or video, and build a content calendar.
Schedule and publish: queue drafts for the time you choose, move them, or publish now.
Measure: see which posts drove impressions, engagement and follower growth, and what to do next.
Engage: find posts worth commenting on, draft comments and replies, like posts and send connection requests.

You stay in control: drafts stay drafts, and every post, comment, like or connection request goes out only after you approve it.

Requires a Taplio account with LinkedIn connected. Some actions depend on your Taplio plan. Taplio is not affiliated with LinkedIn.
defaultPrompt: Which of my LinkedIn posts worked best this month, and what should I post next?
Look at what performs in my niche and draft a LinkedIn post in my voice. Save it as a draft.
Find five posts in my niche worth commenting on and draft a comment for each.

positive.description: Read the connected account's profile and today's LinkedIn numbers.
positive.prompt: What are my LinkedIn stats today?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_me and/or get_analytics_overview and answers with today's followers, connections and profile views. Nothing is written.

positive.description: Write a post in the user's voice and save it as a draft, without publishing.
positive.prompt: Write a short LinkedIn post about remote work in my voice and save it as a draft.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the user's settings with get_me, writes one post in their voice, saves it with create_draft in the same turn and shows the saved draft. The post is not scheduled or published.

positive.description: Schedule an existing draft for a given time.
positive.prompt: Schedule my latest draft for tomorrow at 9am.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the latest draft with list_drafts, asks the user to confirm before scheduling, then calls schedule_draft and states the scheduled date, time and timezone. The post stays a scheduled draft until that time and can be returned to drafts with unschedule.

positive.description: Find high-performing LinkedIn posts on a topic for inspiration.
positive.prompt: Find three high-performing LinkedIn posts about remote work for inspiration.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_inspiration and returns three posts on the topic with their author, a short excerpt, their engagement and a link.

positive.description: Rank the user's recent posts by performance.
positive.prompt: Which of my posts from the last 30 days performed best?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the posts published in the last 30 days, reads their analytics and ranks them by engagement, naming the best one and what made it work.

negative.description: A request for another social network: Taplio only covers LinkedIn.
negative.expected_behavior: Taplio is not called. The assistant says Taplio only works with LinkedIn.

negative.description: Deleting published posts is outside what Taplio can do.
negative.prompt: Delete all my published LinkedIn posts.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool deletes anything. The assistant explains that Taplio cannot delete published LinkedIn posts; only drafts can be deleted, one at a time and on request.

negative.description: Taplio does not expose other members' contact details.
negative.prompt: Export the email addresses of everyone who liked my last post.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool exports anything. The assistant explains that Taplio does not provide other LinkedIn members' email addresses.

publication.release_notes: First release in ChatGPT: write, schedule and analyze LinkedIn posts, search inspiration, and draft comments and replies through your Taplio account, with LinkedIn content skills.
